relationships.subject: MSC-derived extracellular vesicles
relationships.evidence_quote: Stimulating ADMSCs with IFNγ and TNF-α produced exosomes carrying miR-34a-5p and 146a-5p that were then delivered to macrophages and induced a shift from the inflammatory M1 phenotype to the anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype

key_findings: Review: MSC-derived EVs regulate ECM turnover, chondrocyte biology, inflammation, bone homeostasis and pain in OA, mostly in small-animal preclinical models.
Only two registered clinical studies use MSC exosomes or conditioned media for OA.
